findings.title: Membership formed through prior acts
findings.claim: The carrier kana places a person among a defined class as a status reached after prior deeds: the focus moves from the preceding passage through difficulty to belonging among those who believe and mutually counsel patience and mercy.
findings.mechanism: Kana carries being or becoming, while thumma supplies ordered succession and min plus the definite relative class supplies a placement relation; the following plural predicates give that placement its enacted content.
findings.reader_payoff: Belonging becomes perceptible as a position formed through what the group does over time, while the ordinary translation remains recoverable.
findings.containment: The packet supports formed membership and status. Thumma may also carry durable aftermath, rhetorical ordering, or both; this finding does not decide among those possibilities.

epistemic.reason: A trusted focus-anchored publication supplies the finding, and the legacy reader-walk record supplies the same kana-based after-acts mechanism as corroboration; both are bounded by the supplied focus relation.

findings.mechanism: The security facet of amanu is activated by its contact with the two reciprocal predicates and their mercy content, while the acceptance facet is held in the same plural relative profile; the combination turns inward assent toward a lived relation of trust and care.
findings.reader_payoff: Faith becomes perceptible as relief from fear and openness to a trustworthy bond, with the focus's communal practices supplying the visible form of that bond.
findings.containment: The freedom here is bounded as release from fear and exposure, and care is bounded by the supplied mercy relation; the packet does not establish a separate literal emancipation narrative.

epistemic.reason: The trusted publication is directly anchored to the focus amanu occurrence and retains both nominated focus branches.

findings.title: Patience as endurance and surety

findings.reader_payoff: Patience becomes visible as a durable presence that can bear another's load, while the ordinary sense of restraint remains in place.
findings.containment: The surety relation is qualified and attached to the reciprocal focus frame. It does not claim that sabr lexically names a companion or legal guarantor in every use.

epistemic.reason: The trusted finding anchors both supplied sabr branches, but the surety branch is explicitly qualified and is retained with its restriction.

findings.title: Collective traction on the difficult ascent
findings.claim: The focus's patience can be read, through the attributed hardship-and-ascent field, as coordinated traction: members keep one another moving and mercy keeps the vulnerable member from being shed by the climb.

Attributed hardship, guidance, elevation, danger, and a steep obstacle form an uphill field; the focus stone and mountain facets give sabr material footing, reciprocal counsel distributes the effort, and mercy directs that effort toward retaining the exposed person.
findings.reader_payoff: Patience becomes a shared way of keeping purchase on a difficult rise, so the two reciprocal predicates describe how movement is sustained rather than merely naming inner endurance.
findings.containment: The terrain is an attributed contextual analogy and leaves open the narrower reading of moral difficulty without a spatial scene. The focus's ordinary endurance meaning remains live.
